description: Use to see what the app printed or why it failed: one app's logcat lines only (its pid; its last pid when not running). Default: the last 40 lines at level >= I, one text line each `HH:MM:SS.mmm L Tag: message`, equal lines in a row folded `(xN)`, stack traces cut to the top 8 app frames. all:true = today's whole output at level V (max 500 lines); since:"1m" limits to recent lines; format:"json" = {lines:[{time, level, tag, message}]}.
name: logs
